contract_completeness: Every required field has an explicit JSON type, shape, defining equation or predicate, and canonicalization rule.

reachable_difference_basis.canonicalization: nonzero RREF rows in pivot order
reachable_difference_basis.definition: canonical RREF basis of least transition-closed difference space

transition_closure_coordinates.canonicalization: keys exactly input alphabet; basis order
transition_closure_coordinates.definition: row i gives coordinates of D_symbol^T*basis_i
transition_closure_coordinates.json_type: object mapping each alphabet symbol to rational matrix

representation_conventions: Indices are zero-based unless a mathematical exponent or degree is explicitly named. Matrices are row-major; nested tensor array order is stated per task.

A rational scalar is a reduced JSON string "n" or "n/d" with positive denominator. JSON integers are used only where the field contract says integer. Floats, decimal approximations, NaN and infinity are invalid.
The submission object has exactly required_fields, with no additional keys. Nested objects likewise use exactly the named keys.
task_rules: An automaton value on word w is alpha^T M_w beta. Build block D_a=diag(M_A,a,M_B,a), start s=(alpha_A,-alpha_B), and output o=(beta_A,beta_B).
reachable_difference_basis is the unique nonzero-row RREF basis of the least row space containing s and closed under v -> D_a^T v for symbols in input alphabet order.
For each symbol, transition_closure_coordinates gives one coordinate row per basis row, satisfying coordinates*B=D_a^T basis_row. output_pairings[i]=basis_row_i dot o and must all be zero.
